claim_boundary: The difference between nominal and inflation-indexed Treasury yields is a market measure of inflation compensation, not pure expected inflation. A four-week rise could coincide with stronger nominal-demand or reflation conditions that support Bitcoin, but it can also reflect inflation-risk and liquidity premia. Exactly one preregistered long-or-cash audit may test this sign; no causal or alpha claim is imported from the source definition.

feature_contract.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis FRED
feature_contract.source_agency: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System (US)

prior_matrix.identity: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis FRED, Five-Year Breakeven Inflation Rate
prior_matrix.finding: The official series is daily, percent, not seasonally adjusted, and is calculated from five-year nominal Treasury and five-year inflation-indexed Treasury yields.
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: The series is derived rather than directly observed and its present-vintage history may be revised; it is not a Bitcoin-specific demand measure.

prior_matrix.identity: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, TIPS Yield Curve and Inflation Compensation
prior_matrix.finding: Inflation compensation is inferred from the difference between nominal Treasury and TIPS yields and can be decomposed conceptually into expected inflation plus an inflation-risk premium.
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: A rise can reflect expected inflation, inflation-risk compensation, market liquidity or term-premium changes; the sign does not establish stronger real activity or future Bitcoin returns.

real_time_design_requirements: Before accessing any historical T5YIE values, freeze a source-feasibility specification for exact FRED CSV identity, weekday lattice, missing-value handling, both-state support, transition count, annual breadth and concentration.

If the source gate permits continuation, seal exact annual FRED CSV responses for T5YIE from 2017-01-01 through 2024-12-31; require unique weekday dates, finite decimal values and explicit holiday blanks.
Construct each calendar week ending Friday from actually published Monday-Friday observations, require three to five observations, take the last available value and do not interpolate holidays.
Make week-ending Friday D usable only at D plus five calendar days 00:00 UTC and valid for at most 168 hours.
Compare each weekly value only with the exact weekly value 28 calendar days earlier; hold the unchanged full-capital spot-BTC parent only when the current value is strictly higher.
Use the same historical BTC corpus, valuation clock, fee, adverse-slippage, cash-yield and capital conventions as the matched buy-and-hold comparator.

Require separate Design and Validation predictive gates before opening matched-capital economics; require return effect, negative-rate effect, drawdown path, annual breadth, support and concentration.

Do not add T10YIE, T5YIFR, nominal yields, real yields, yield-curve spreads, Fed balance sheet, dollar, financial conditions, moving averages, z-scores, magnitude cutoffs, alternate lags, inverse rules, fractional sizing, short legs or post-outcome exceptions.

Do not reinterpret the closed real-yield, term-spread, broad-dollar, Fed balance-sheet, Treasury-liquidity, M2 or NFCI branches as evidence for this family; their mechanisms remain permanently closed.
Do not open post-2024 data; any historical pass remains REPORTED_NOT_ACTIVATED and requires separately sealed independent OOS.
uncertainty: T5YIE combines expected inflation with inflation-risk and potentially liquidity premia, so the proposed reflation-support interpretation is not uniquely identified.
The present-vintage FRED series can contain revisions; original release values and a complete revision history remain MISSING_PROOF.
Bitcoin sensitivity to macro conditions can vary across monetary, liquidity and risk regimes.
The four-week horizon and positive sign are preregistered economic conventions, not parameters established by the official sources.
No historical T5YIE values, BTC outcome, post-2024 observation, candidate, OOS or Trading path was accessed while freezing this prior.
